body:
## Purpose This PR deprecates and remove PyAV backend from video io for two reasons: 1. Poor performance: PyAV has a super poor performance comparing other CPU backend like OpenCV/Torchcodec, because it only provides seek api which is inefficient for frames sampling. Even if with sparse sampling optimization, it still only wins OpenCV in super sparse case which is quite rare (see https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/44598#issue-4593570914) 2. PyAV is an optional dependency in `vllm[audio]` with GNU license issue in its bundled ffmpeg, while Torchcodec has been added to commom deps and work out of box. Therefore, I don't see too much reasons for maintaining an optional video backend with poor performance and license issue. In the follow up PRs, we will try to migrate audio IO to `torchcodec` and `torchaudio`, so that we can enable audio support by default (see https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51826) (Thanks @JaredforReal for helping benchmarking each video backend!) ## Test Plan ## Test Result ---
